item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Ukrainian forces are hitting deep Russian targets, including a titanium plant over 1,400 km from the border, airports, a Tolyatti factory and a Krasnodar Krai airfield, while a secretive deep-strike unit is extending attacks up to 2,500 km. Russian forces continue drone and missile strikes on Ukrainian civilian sites, killing eight and injuring 51 in recent attacks that included a drone strike on a residential building in Vinnytsia. In occupied Oleshky a local cease-fire negotiated by Melania Trump has reduced fighting, and a separate truce was agreed for another town. Starlink speed restrictions have been lifted, restoring stable connectivity for Ukraine's military. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

An Israeli airstrike hit a building in Nuseirat, Gaza, and video shows the impact. Hamas is said to be threatening an Oct. 7‑style attack in response to an IDF advance in Gaza, and the IDF reported killing two terror operatives involved in funding Hamas in strikes last week. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

Al Shabaab detonated an IED in Mandera, injuring six civilians, and the ICRC treated 148 wounded after heavy combat in Baidoa. Ethiopia has withdrawn more than 3,000 troops and will not intervene in the South West State conflict, and a UAE drone strike in Puntland killed four family members, including a pregnant teenager. item.description:
Ebola has reached an eighth province in eastern DRC, prompting alerts in Lubumbashi and border closures by Kenya and Uganda after 12 truck drivers were killed. The ADF continues attacks in Ituri while the FRN operates near Lubumbashi, and both UPDF and FARDC are conducting joint operations against ADF commanders in the region. A mercenary force suffered combat casualties in the Congo, and rebel-linked violence has led to civilian deaths. The conflict produced 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
